summary.result: Employing share indicators and comparative ratio indicators (resulting in eight composite indicators), this study showed that when share indicators are applied, Koreaʹs appropriate reduction requirement rate is relatively low at 1~2%.
summary.background: There has been some concern regarding whether the INDCs communicated are sufficient to achieve the emissions reduction needed to hold the increase in global temperature to 2℃ above pre‐industrial levels.
summary.method: In a similar vein, when share indicators are applied, Koreaʹs 2030 target is very ambitious compared to other countries, while the opposite is seen with comparative ratio indicators.
